sloka: पुष्प ओघेण अनुबद्धन्ते करिष्यति तत् अद्य कहः ।येन दत्तम् महत् युद्धम् गन्धर्वस्य महात्मनः ॥४-२२-२८॥
transliteration: puṣpa ogheṇa anubaddhante kariṣyati tat adya kahaḥ ।yena dattam mahat yuddham gandharvasya mahātmanaḥ ॥4-22-28॥

translations.english: 'Great soul, Vali endowed with stout shoulders joined a duel with a gandharva called Golabha for fifteen years nonstop night and day.
